character_profiles.name: King Theron
character_profiles.build: Lean but regal, not overly muscular, conveying thoughtfulness rather than brute strength.
character_profiles.face_details: Serious and thoughtful expression, with kind, introspective eyes. A strong, defined jawline and a noble, slightly pensive countenance.
character_profiles.hair: Dark brown, neatly styled but with a subtle natural wave, medium length, falling just above the collar.
character_profiles.outfit: Understated royal attire focused on dignity rather than ostentation. A deep crimson tunic with subtle gold embroidery at the collar and cuffs, worn under a charcoal grey cloak lined with dark sapphire blue. A simple, elegant golden circlet rests on his head, rather than a full crown.
character_profiles.distinguishing_features: A subtle, almost faded scar above his left eyebrow (from a childhood incident), and a heavy silver signet ring with a minimalist emblem on his right hand.
character_profiles.reference_prompt: A young King Theron, in his early 20s, with a lean but regal build, conveying thoughtfulness rather than brute strength. He has a serious and thoughtful expression, with kind, introspective eyes set in a strong, defined jawline and a noble, slightly pensive countenance. His dark brown hair is neatly styled but with a subtle natural wave, medium length, falling just above the collar. He wears understated royal attire: a deep crimson tunic with subtle gold embroidery at the collar and cuffs, under a charcoal grey cloak lined with dark sapphire blue. A simple, elegant golden circlet rests on his head. His dominant colors are deep crimson, sapphire blue, muted gold, charcoal grey, and cream. Distinguishing features include a subtle, almost faded scar above his left eyebrow and a heavy silver signet ring with a minimalist emblem on his right hand. The art style is realistic and painterly, akin to classical portraiture, featuring dramatic lighting, rich textures, and a solemn, dignified, and detailed fantasy art aesthetic with expressive qualities.
